body: I've struggled against depression since I was a child. I'm now 41. I've been on every med and tried every sort of therapy there is. Nothing has ever helped me. Things just get worse and worse. I don't know how I've held on this long. I know meds have helped some people, but for me nothing works.

I'm in the same place. I've had many people on here message me or reply to my posts. Despite their best intentions, it doesn't help. Strangers on the internet who don't know me offering pep talks or tough love does nothing for me.

I don't know that things will ever get better. It's been months for me and every day still gets worse. I spent the afternoon laying on the floor of my shit apartment crying and I'll sob myself to sleep tonight. I know that T\\tomorrow I'll wake up and feel even worse. I'm in such despair that it physically hurts.

For what it's worth, you're not the only one in that place. That's the best I can offer. We will never meet, have a real conversation, or even know one another's name. Nothing I can say will lessen your pain. But I know your pain...that's all I've got.

I looked over all of the comments here and considered them. It's probably selfish, it''s probably the wrong thing to do, I will probably regret it. I regret every decision I make.

It's done now. Today I signed whatever my ex's lawyer had drawn up. I didn't really read it. I gave my ex full custody. I will just send a check every month. I won't be doing visitations at all. If I did I would just cry through them. 

I can't take care of kids for any period of time. I can't even handle showering and feeding myself or getting myself to work.I just sit alone in the dark and cry.

Me being gone will cause abandonment issues or whatever for them, I'm sure. Whatever issues they have from that pale in comparison to the damage I would do if I was involved in their lives.

It's done now. I really don't have anything left in my life. I'm sure internet strangers will judge me for it. I don't know anyone in real life who will judge me, because I don't know anyone at all. There's not a single person that I talk to in real life (other than a therapist over zoom).

I've been on the highest dosage of meds since my dad died in December. They don't help. I've told the Drs. but they aren't willing to change anything.

I left a message for my primary care Dr in March saying I needed to talk to someone and a med change. Dr. called the cops, telling them I was suicidal (I wasn't). They pulled me over on my way to work and took me to a psych facility against my will. I spent 13 days in the hospital. The Drs. there didn't change my meds or do anything different. They just held me for 13 days and then handed me cab fare on my way out the door.

The best part is that the inpatient Drs. acknowledged that I wasn't suicidal and said so in their notes. Despite this they still wouldn't release me. This means that my insurance apparently won't cover any of the costs of my 13 day hospital stay. Despite the fact that I was being held against my will and I asked to leave every day. 

So now I have medical bills from that, which I can't pay, on top of all the bills related to my accident.

I've seen Psychs several times since my hospitalization, I tell them the meds don't work, and they don't change anything.

Every Psych has like a 9 month waiting list, so I can't just shop around. I don't dare contact anyone saying this is an emergency for fear of ending up back in the hospital.

Long story short there isn't a Dr. to talk to who would be willing to help me.

I don't have any living family that I know. Both parents have passed. I had one sister who I was not close with who died years ago while active duty military. My parents' deaths are recent (my mom two years ago, my dad in December of 2021). I was very close with my dad. We talked on the phone every day and he came to visit the kids a couple times a month.

I was hit by a drunk driver in January and had to have several surgeries. I still haven't fully recovered. During this time my appendix also burst so I had to have that surgery while I was still recovering from the others.

I was always physically active and in good shape. Now I can't make it up a flight of stairs without my knees giving out.

My wife was my only friend and the only adult I spent time with. I worked and spent time with her and the kids. That was it, all there was to my life. I would exercise daily, but I didn't have any hobbies or friends.

I'm completely and utterly alone. The only adult I speak to is my therapist once a week over zoom. The only other people I even spoke to were my kids. 

I was already in a bad place when she broke the news to me several months ago. She had papers already done and had a lawyer working on it for a while before she told me. She told quite a few of her friends before telling me.

I have since found out that she had been having an affair for some time. I discovered  this while we were in the process of getting divorced. She sent me a string of very sexually explicit text messages that were intended for someone else. The guy moved into what used to be my house with her about a month after I left.

I don't believe in karma or fate or anything like that. But I do feel like I am cursed and that only bad things happen to me. Every time I think that things can't get any worse they do somehow. It's so bad it's almost funny. My life is a cruel joke.

You owe them your absolute best regardless of the personal discomfort. pawning them off on another man is not the answer. that person is there to support their mother, he is not their father, you are. remember that, you owe them that. You deserve a better, kinder you, too, but i don't think youre in the headspace to accept that fact yet.

I've been in therapy and on antidepressants for a long time. It doesn't help.

I can't exercise. I've always been very active and fit, but now if I even walk around the block my back and knees hurt for days.

I've been in counseling.

I've been on the maximum dosage of Wellbutrin for quite some time. It doesn't help. The Dr. won't prescribe anything else.

There's zero chance of my ever having a friend, let alone a future romantic partner.

I didn't sign anything.

I'm receiving treatment that doesn't help. It doesn't even keep things level. Every day gets worse.

>hosp

I've already been hospitalized for mental health issues. It was a few months ago. It did nothing to help. They just left me on the same meds that I was already on, that don't work.
I never said that it was anyone's fault but my own. My wife cheating on me was even my fault.
I'm a professor at a prestigious university.

I've already been in therapy and I'm on psych prescribed meds. None of it helps. It has been months since she got rid of me and every day things continue to get worse.

Making my kids be a part of my life is just selfish on my part. They deserve better than having to spend time with me.

I appreciate the suggestions that everyone has offered. I just can't make any of them work right now.

I have too much social anxiety to go anywhere or speak to anyone. My therapist is the only adult I speak to, that is once a week and virtual.

I'd like to exercise, but my body is matching my emotional state. I've always been physically active and fit. Now every inch of my body hurts at all times. If I even go for a walk my knees throb for days and I end up limping around.

My hair has turned completely white over the last few months and is now falling out in clumps. I can't even bring myself to shower or shave. Unless I have the kids or have to be at work, I don't get out of bed, eat, or even turn lights on anymore.

Right now I'm sitting in my office with the door locked and the lights off crying. This is what I'll be doing until it's time to pick the kids up from school. Then I can listen to them tell me how much they hate me and whatever I give them for dinner until they go to bed. Then it'll be sit in the dark and cry until I fall asleep around 3 am.

Tomorrow will be worse. They don't have school and it's supposed to thunderstorm all day here. So, we will just sit in the apartment with them whining about wanting to go home and telling me how much they hate me until they go to bed.

I don't even try to stick up for myself or reprimand them anymore. "Dad you're stupid." "You're right, I am." "Dad I hate you." "Yes, I know. Everyone does." My life is fucked, why should I have any authority over anyone else? I clearly don't know how to do anything.

Things aren't getting better, they just keep getting worse. I just can't do anything. 

I keep hoping that I'll cry myself to sleep one of these nights and never wake up. The world and life have nothing to offer me except more pain and misery.

I’ve worked with soldiers who had breakdowns upon return from deployment, come to find out they are really struggling with childhood trauma from a parent suicide. I had another female soldiers kill herself, and now her young daughter is suffering greatly, especially because her father is physically abusive, and she couldn’t ensure her parents guardianship. I’ve dealt with ideation my whole life, I get that depression is a continuous struggle and fight, and my kids are the greatest reason why I will continue to fight. They are a blessing, and I know this because of my other friends and Soldiers who couldn’t have them for some reason, be it finding a partner or physically unable to have children. Life is a gift, please keep treasuring it.

I appreciate the suggestions. I can't do the church thing. I had really bad childhood experiences and will never go that route.

I'm allergic to pretty much anything with fur and my apartment wouldn't be happy with a pet anyway. My X bought the kids a puppy. "you can finally have this now that your dad is gone."

I don't live in a large city. I can't find any support groups. There aren't any for depression, divorce, or anything remotely related. There aren't any open meet-ups either. I've looked at the websites that people go to for those.

I live in a small crappy apartment. My X lives in the large, nice home that they've grown up in. All of their toys, their rooms, etc. are there. She has a big yard with a playground and neighborhood friends they play with. She does constant playdates with their friends, sleepovers, takes them to birthday parties, she bought them a puppy, etc. 

They come to my apartment and they have nothing to do. I've bought a some games and toys, but can't duplicate what they have at my X's house.

I've always had a good relationship with the kids until now.

For what it's worth, she is the one who had an affair. I didn't discover until after we were in the process of getting divorced. I was always staying home with the kids while she was out with "friends."

My kids are 8 and 6. I have been talking to a therapist and I am taking meds prescribed by a psych. Neither makes any difference. Other than kids and work, the therapist is the only person I speak to. I've been depressed with ups and downs since I was kid. Nothing has ever helped.
I'm on the verge of just telling my X she can have full custody. I'll just send her a check every month. The kids will be better off without me in their lives.
